data.name: Azhara
data.gender_notes: Azhara is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'az-harah', meaning 'glorified, exalted, or fortified'. In Islamic history, Azhara is often associated with the virtues of patience, courage, and resilience. The name is also said to symbolize spiritual growth and enlightenment. The name Azhara carries the meaning “Glorified, Exalted” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Azhara usually hope their child will grow to embody glorified, exalted and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_arabic.name: أزهرة

in_urdu.name: ازہرا

in_urdu.long_meaning: ازہرا نام عربی زبان کی root 'ز-ه-ر' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے کھلنا یا ظاہر ہونا۔ یہ نام خوبصورت لڑکی یا کھلنے والے پھول کے معنی میں ہے۔ اسلامی ثقافت میں، یہ نام جمال اور خوبی کی علامت ہے، اور اس کا ذکر قرآن مجید میں بھی آیا ہے۔
